decisions.reason: As a flagship product close to the firm’s core dosimetry and QA business in a growing, R&D-intensive market, it remains a strategically valuable option with little evidence that its value has been resolved negatively.

Because this oncology risk-management software builds on the established offer and software can usually be carried at relatively low cost while market uncertainty resolves, the firm is more likely to retain it than abandon it now despite somewhat higher adoption uncertainty than for core hardware.
